_about: Z30: zone leftovers (rename by item, dismantle DB request, holy-promise ring transfer, academy-member ring search, title broadcasts, guild list request, SP stone broadcast). Offsets are payload offsets (after the 2-byte opcode). Layouts read in the 2016 zone code; names and structs from the 2016 zone PDB (pdb2016). See docs/pseudocode/zone/Z30-leftovers.md.

0xb40f.name: NC_USER_CONNECTION_ZONE_CHANGE_CHAR_ID_CMD
0xb40f.basis: zone wms_NC_USER_CONNECTION_ZONE_CHANGE_CHAR_ID_CMD FUN_0044caa0; sender wm CWMClientSession::CharIDChange FUN_00431dd0 (broadcast to all zones)
fields: 1 = relations reset: the zone drops the member from its party / raid copy

0x3476.name: NC_ITEMDB_DISMANTLE_REQ
fields: 0x2b each: u8 create, u16 product, u16 productuselot_log, union { PROTO_ITEM_ATTRCHANGE { u64 regnum, u16 attr = attribute-data offset, ITEM_INVEN location } (create 0) | PROTO_ITEM_CREATE { u32 owner, MAPPOS map, ITEM_INVEN location, u64 regnum, u16 itemid, u16 attr = attribute-data offset } (create 1) }
0x3476.notes: variable length: after produce[] the attribute data of each produce entry is appended (ItemAttributeClass vt 4); the attr words point at it, relative to the payload start

0x9436.name: NC_HOLY_PROMISE_CENTRANSFER_RNG
0x9436.notes: 0x23 bytes; no 2016 originator (the spending hook is empty)

0x10ad.name: NC_CHAR_PLAYERSEARCH_BY_NORMAL_USER_RNG
fields: {u8 machine = origin zone, u16 handle = master handle, u32 regnum = master charNo}

0x10ae.name: NC_CHAR_PLAYERFOUND_BY_NORMAL_USER_RNG
0x10ae.notes: 0x31 bytes (the 2016 PDB also has a 0x30-byte definition without modeIDLv; the zone writes and reads 0x31)

0x6003.name: NC_CT_SET_SOMEONECHANGE_CMD
0x6003.basis: zone CCharacterTitleZone::Send_NC_CT_SET_CURRENT_ACK FUN_005ca9e0 (only after Error 0xA01, not on NameHide maps); client FUN_00499700
0x6003.notes: 6 bytes, broadcast to the players in sight

0x7446.name: NC_GUILD_ZONE_LIST_REQ
fields: pp_SetPacketLen(3): one byte after the opcode, never written
0x7446.notes: sent once per process (gz_IsSendReq); the byte is never written (original bug Z30-B8); answer 0x7447 (Z08 §8)

0x500c.name: NC_SOULSTONE_SP_SOMEONEUSE_CMD

0x500c.notes: broadcast to the players in sight
